answers.reason: The junior professor holds no office granting a seat in the university-wide senate.
Budget planning involves office holders of higher rank due to the university-wide plan.
Professors are typically involved in appointment committees, but specific lower bodies depend on regulations; however, as a professor, they are eligible for faculty-level academic matters.
The junior professor is a member of the faculty and participates in faculty affairs.
As an academic staff member of the faculty, the junior professor takes part in faculty study matters.
Examination boards deal with student matters where professors are eligible.
The junior professor leads a research group and is eligible for internal research funding.
The junior professor teaches and is involved in degree programmes.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled within the faculty by relevant academic staff.
Orientation week planning is generally open or organized by faculty members including staff.
